commands.summary: Plan and execute the add company attributes reverse-ETL action
examples: pm customerly add company attributes apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: external mutation; adds/overwrites custom attribute values (and optionally renames) a live company
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the add tag reverse-ETL action
examples: pm customerly add tag apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: external mutation; adds or removes a tag on one or more live users/leads
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the add user attributes reverse-ETL action
examples: pm customerly add user attributes apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: external mutation; adds/overwrites custom attribute values on a live user
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
commands.notes: named_dependency=engine.reverse_etl_scalar_flag_contract: the reverse-ETL command surface cannot faithfully expose this action's required object or array record fields as scalar flags

commands.summary: Plan and execute the add user to company reverse-ETL action
examples: pm customerly add user to company apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: external mutation; links a live user to a company, creating the company if it does not already exist
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete lead reverse-ETL action
examples: pm customerly delete lead apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: external mutation; irreversibly deletes a live Customerly lead and every associated record; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete tag reverse-ETL action
examples: pm customerly delete tag apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: external mutation; permanently removes a tag definition from the app; it is un-applied from every contact that carried it; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete user reverse-ETL action
examples: pm customerly delete user apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: external mutation; irreversibly deletes a live Customerly user and every conversation/survey/campaign record tied to them; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

examples: pm customerly leads list --json

commands.summary: Plan and execute the send message reverse-ETL action
examples: pm customerly send message apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: sends a user-visible message from Customerly on the sender's behalf; may notify the recipient
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
commands.notes: named_dependency=engine.reverse_etl_scalar_flag_contract: the reverse-ETL command surface cannot faithfully expose this action's required object or array record fields as scalar flags

commands.summary: Plan and execute the unsubscribe user reverse-ETL action
examples: pm customerly unsubscribe user apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: external mutation; unsubscribes a live user from Customerly messaging; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
